last_round.quote: The round was led by Redpoint Ventures, with participation from Y Combinator ... as well as a group of angel investors that includes former Heroku CEO Adam Gross, former GitHub CTO Jason Warner, GitLab's Sébastien Pahl and LaunchDarkly co-founder and CEO, John Kodumal.

note: YC W20 company confirmed to share the signadot.com domain (founders Arjun Iyer and Anirudh Ramanathan).
